changelog:
Academic Suite v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Released the academic-suite meta-skill package for one-click installation of the full academic research and writing pipeline.
- Integrates all 8 core dependencies: academic-pipeline v3.5, academic-search, deep-research, academic-paper, academic-paper-reviewer, humanizer, humanizer-zh, ima-skills, and integrity_verification_agent.
- Unified 12-stage automated workflow covering literature search, research, writing, integrity checking, peer review, AI-dehumanization, and publication formatting.
- Includes enhanced setup prompts and expanded configuration options for a seamless start.
- Provides updated documentation and troubleshooting guides for quick onboarding.
